title: Generation and differentiation of chemically derived hepatic progenitors from mouse primary hepatocytes
protocol: Resuspend the mPHs in hepatocyte culture medium.
Seed the freshly isolated mPHs on a collagen-coated plate at 2,000 cells/cm² and incubate overnight (10-16 h) with 5% CO₂ at 37°C.
Change hepatocyte culture medium to reprogramming medium.
Culture the cells until they reach 75%-80% confluence.
Prewarm DPBS and TrypLE to room temperature (20°C-25°C).
Prepare a collagen-coated plate, aspirate the collagen solution, wash the plate using DPBS, and add 7 ml of reprogramming medium.
Aspirate the cultured medium and wash the cells with 2-3 ml DPBS.
Add 2 mL TrypLE Express Enzyme and incubate for 5 min at 37°C.
Detach the cells by gently pipetting and transfer to a 15 mL tube with 7 mL of reprogramming medium.
Centrifuge at 200 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet with 4 mL reprogramming medium.
Seed 1 mL of cells into a prepared 10 cm² plate.
Incubate in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO₂ at 37°C.
Count 1 × 10⁵ cells and add reprogramming medium until total volume is 900 μL.
Add 100 μL DMSO and transfer each sample to a cryo-tube.
Place the cryo-tubes into a freezing container and store at −80°C deep freezer.
Prewarm the reprogramming medium and water bath.
Prepare a collagen-coated plate, aspirate the collagen solution, wash the plate using DPBS, and add 7 mL of reprogramming medium to a standard 10 cm² plate.
Thaw frozen CdHs in a 37°C water bath and slowly transfer into a 15 mL tube with prewarmed 9 mL reprogramming medium.
Centrifuge at 200 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL reprogramming medium.
Seed the cells into a prepared 10 cm² collagen-coated plate.
Incubate in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO₂ at 37°C.
Prewarm the reprogramming medium and water bath to 37°C.
Prepare a collagen-coated plate by aspirating the collagen solution and washing with DPBS.
Add 1.5 mL of reprogramming medium to the collagen-coated plate in a 6-well plate.
Seed CdHs on the collagen-coated plates at a density of 1,000 cells/cm².
Incubate for 1 day in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO₂ at 37°C.
Change the reprogramming medium to hepatic differentiation medium after 1 day.
Change the medium every two days.
Aspirate the culture medium after 6 days of incubation.
Overlay CdHs with Matrigel mixture.
Thaw the Matrigel in ice.
Prepare the ice-cold hepatic differentiation medium.
Dilute the Matrigel with ice-cold hepatic differentiation medium at a ratio of 1:7 on ice.
Incubate for 2 days in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO₂ at 37°C.
Collect conditioned medium on days 0, 2, 4, and 6 during hepatic differentiation process.
Add ice-cold DMEM/F-12 (1 mL / 1,000 cells) to the cells and incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Gently aspirate the Matrigel mixture using a pipette without disturbing the cells.
Add ice-cold DPBS (1 mL / 1,000 cells) to the cells and gently aspirate it.
Incubate cells with Tryp/LE for 3 min at 37°C.
Transfer detached cells from the collagen-coated plate to a 15 mL tube containing 9 mL of ice-cold DMEM/F-12.
Centrifuge cells at 200 g for 5 min at 4°C and aspirate the supernatant.
If necessary, add ice-cold DPBS, resuspend the pellet, and centrifuge again to remove excess Matrigel.
Isolate mRNA using TRIzol.
Add 1 mL of ice-cold DPBS to the cells and incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Harvest the CdHs using Tryp/LE in the same manner as the passaging method.
Resuspend the pellet with cholangiocytic differentiation medium at a density of 1 × 10^5 cells/well in a 6-well plate.
Mix the cells with an equal volume of collagen type I (pH 7.0) on ice.
Adjust collagen type I to pH 7.0 using NaOH or HCl if necessary, then mix with the cells.
Incubate for 30 min at 37°C.
Gently add 1 ml of prewarmed cholangiocytic differentiation medium.
Incubate for 7 days in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO2 at 37°C.
Change the medium every two days using fresh cholangiocytic differentiation medium.
Gently aspirate the cultured medium and wash with 1 mL DPBS for mRNA isolation.
Aspirate the DPBS and add TRIzol or lysis buffer depending on the mRNA isolation methods.
Gently aspirate the cultured medium and wash with 1 mL DPBS for immunocytochemistry sampling.
Fix cells with 4% paraformaldehyde, methanol, etc., according to the experimenter’s protocol.
